ext.links.name: Links
links.d_ref_policy: Set the document-wide default referrer policy (applied to all outgoing requests: links, images, scripts, etc.) using the <meta name="referrer"> element.
links.d_schemas: Make links in task titles and notes clickable when the text starts with one of the supported URL schemes. This also works for Markdown links, e.g. [Link Title](schema:url).
